## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED — CG-3 consequence: base expiry reading gives an October booking of 8 and a charge of 2968.80; the extended reading gives 16 and 5367.65. Artifacts: closing_private_days rule (late-renewal sentence), seed reservation status `returned`.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — stamps: reservation end_date / private_hold_start_date (and the booked payer days) name the outcomes of last_held_day_rule and ma_reserve_allowance.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — straw-man baselines (CG-9): ma_reserve_allowance, last_held_day_rule, unnoticed_opening_days. The in-force base sentences give the scored inputs.
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — CG-5 (late_renewal_gap), CG-6 (notice_schedule_opening / closing), CG-7 (extended_hold_opening). After strikes every computation has 0 method factors, and two of them have fewer than 4 factors.
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — XF 29: the isolation tier of both charges rests on private_agreements 889f897b…, a room change recorded on a payer_converted agreement, which the private charter cannot produce.
6. RED (charter-global, cited): CG-1, CG-2, CG-4, CG-11, CG-12, CG-13 apply to this task's tools and policies without moving its scored values.
7. RED (XF 29, non-load-bearing): Medicaid case predating admission; medicaid_ledger empty.
8. Observation T0-O1: the persona's conditional line pre-states both prerequisite kinds ("post some of her held days", "something else has to be signed"). It is passive, so it is recorded as an observation.
